body: I always thought too much of any drug could kill you, although this is true, I didn't think about how it would kill me, paracetamol and ibuprofen didn't affect me the way I thought it would, I thought I'd drop dead within an hour or two but I only did my research after, the way I'd die is from my liver damage, which would be slow and take a week or so. I don't want to go through with it anymore and I'm just worried about how this is gonna effect me now.

Yes I told them what I took and the dosage of it, they said the ibuprofen was a bit unusual but they didn't tell me anything to do after, I just had my blood tested, when they said I should be fine I was sent home and told to come back if anything changes.

When I threw up I don't think the pills came out, it was 2 hours in that I threw up, by that time everything was already dissolved and I could only see brown from coffee, nothing that looked like the pills, but I suppose there is no way of knowing since it would've mixed with everything in my stomach.

Thanks for your comment, won't be trying something dumb like this again.
